d: Nepal's Minister for Foreign Affairs Shishir Khanal addressed a media briefing detailing the major outcomes of the high-level bilateral visit to India. He announced that Nepal has secured transit access to Gujarat's Deendayal Port in Kandla and Odisha's Paradip Port alongside existing facilities at Kolkata and Visakhapatnam, calling it a major breakthrough for Nepal's international trade. Highlighting the talks held between the Prime Ministers at Hyderabad House in New Delhi, Khanal noted the issuance of a landmark Joint Vision Document titled 'Viksit Bharat, Samunnat Nepal'.
